source.transcription: Printed formation tables transcribed from the official PDF. Each row retains its printed page, temperature, and PDF text line locator.

transformation: Use the printed (H-H298)/T and S columns to form Hinc=T*(H-H298)/T, then interpolate Hinc and S linearly between source nodes. Runtime Gapp=1000*(ΔfH298+Hinc)-T*S. Printed ΔfG and log Kf are retained for source checks; no fitted Cp polynomial is used.
selection_rule: Select the lowest apparent G among phases in this R&H dataset only. Existing condensate, JANAF, Barin, and Berman sources retain precedence.
